description: Find slots that play like a given slot, scored on mechanic, grid, volatility, max win, themes and features. Each match comes with a similarity score from 0 to 100 and the reasons it is similar. Use it for "games like X"; to filter by specs instead, use search_slots.

limit.description: How many similar slots to return (1-25)

slot.description: Slot id, slug or name; a partial name or a small typo still resolves

name: similar_slots
title: Find similar slots
